suspects.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
suspects.personality: Ambitious, resentful, outwardly calm but prone to outbursts when cornered.
suspects.physicalDescription: Tall and gaunt with sharp features, thinning dark hair, and piercing grey eyes. He often wears tweed jackets and carries an air of intellectual superiority.
suspects.trueAlibi: He visited Elias Thorne's study to confront him about the Obsidian Codex and struck him during an argument, killing him. He then fled with the grimoire.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was at the Royal Observatory all evening, meticulously cataloging celestial events. I haven't seen Elias in months.
suspects.trueMotive: Desperation for Elias's rare collection, particularly the Obsidian Codex, to alleviate his own financial ruin and perceived intellectual inferiority.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He stole the Obsidian Codex from Elias's study after murdering him.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes visibly agitated when the Obsidian Codex is mentioned, and his hands tremble.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Silas Croft had a falling out with Elias and believes he can frame him. He dismisses Elara Vance as a mere 'opportunist'.

suspects.name: Silas Croft
suspects.personality: Bitter, prone to dramatics, drinks heavily, holds grudges.
suspects.physicalDescription: Stocky build with a receding hairline, a perpetually scowling face, and rough hands. He favors worn, dark clothing.
suspects.trueAlibi: He went to Elias Thorne's property late at night to retrieve a personal item he felt Elias owed him, but seeing the house dark and sensing trouble, he left without entering. He was at the Black Cat tavern for most of the evening.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Elias and I had a disagreement, but I would never harm him. I was at the Black Cat tavern drowning my sorrows all night.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He briefly visited Elias's property on the night of the murder, intending to confront him about a past grievance, but left without seeing him.
suspects.lyingTells: Avoids eye contact when discussing his visit to Elias's property, and his voice becomes hoarse.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Aris Thorne was jealous of Elias's collection and that Elara Vance was often seen at Elias's house.

suspects.name: Elara Vance
suspects.personality: Pragmatic, observant, outwardly professional but harbors a keen interest in Elias's collection.
suspects.physicalDescription: Graceful with dark, wavy hair often tied back, intelligent green eyes, and a slender build. She dresses impeccably in practical yet elegant attire.
suspects.trueAlibi: She was working late in her studio across town, restoring a painting for another client. She left her studio around 11:30 PM.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was diligently working in my studio all evening. Elias and I were discussing a potential acquisition for his collection, but I left his residence hours before his estimated time of death.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Aris Thorne visited Elias frequently, often arguing about acquisitions. She also knows Silas Croft had a bitter falling out with Elias over a disputed artifact.

suspects.name: Professor Alistair Finch
suspects.personality: Scholarly, somewhat absent-minded, genuinely grieved by Elias's death.
suspects.physicalDescription: Distinguished with grey, thinning hair, a prominent nose, and kind, blue eyes behind spectacles. He often wears a tweed suit and carries a worn leather satchel.
suspects.trueAlibi: He was at home, researching ancient texts for his upcoming book. He spoke to Elias on the phone earlier in the evening, discussing a historical query.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Elias was a dear friend. I was at home, engrossed in my research. We spoke briefly on the phone earlier that evening.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Aris Thorne was Elias's estranged brother and had a long-standing rivalry over collecting. He also knows Silas Croft was a former associate with whom Elias had a severe falling out.
